objective: Phase A: extend the established isolated coin-optimization laboratory from Core 10x250 to Core+Satellite 15x250 by optimizing SUIUSDC, NEARUSDC, UNIUSDC, AAVEUSDC and BCHUSDC independently with 250 USDC each over the same canonical three-year window. Phase B: after individual Satellite validation, integrate only validated Satellites as idle-capital gap fillers into the unchanged one-shared-250-USDC ten-Core product, with absolute Core preemption.
priorities: Treat isolated 10x250 / 15x250 as per-market optimization evidence: 250 USDC separately for each market. It is not the live/shared account.
Preserve protected Core 10 profiles and exact-head f649 evidence. Do not retune Core to make Satellites look better.
Optimize the five primary Satellites independently with 250 USDC each, adaptive training-only generations, baseline/stress costs and Direct-USDC rejection-only validation.
Each Satellite may have its own independently optimized parameters; do not require one shared Satellite profile.
Only after isolated validation move to the actual shared 250-USDC product replay.
In the shared product, Satellites use only Core-idle/free capacity and ANY executable Core signal closes/yields the Satellite at the next executable open.
Final product success is measured on the same shared 250-USDC account against Core-only: higher after-cost ending equity and materially lower idle time without Core regression.
research_fronts: clean unchanged V1 baseline on SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH
bounded per-market V1 evolution without Core-V6 template inheritance
short-horizon exits and handoff only after the five Satellite entry/exit strategies themselves are suitable
success_rule: Phase A must produce individually robust Satellite profiles under isolated 250-USDC tests. Phase B must then demonstrate that validated Satellites increase the same one-shared-250-USDC Core account after costs/stress while reducing idle time; isolated 15x250 aggregate is never presented as live/shared performance.

profit_concession.note: For the final satellite/router architecture, higher activity is not allowed to buy lower robust shared-account profit. Research diagnostics may explore trade-offs, but promotion requires non-regressive baseline and stress performance.
